title: calcPctr: extend SwephProvider for numbered asteroids and planet moons
description:
SwephProvider currently only routes main asteroid bodies (Chiron–Vesta, IDs 12–17) to main_asteroid_files. Numbered asteroids (Body::Asteroid, individual .se1 files) and planet moons (Body::PlanetMoon, sepm files) hit the else branch and look up in planet_files, which doesn't contain them → BeyondEphemerisLimits.

Same pattern as the c3c27cb fix: add asteroid_files and planet_moon_files to SwephProvider, route by body type. For numbered asteroids, the AsteroidProvider pattern (evaluate from individual file, add sun_bary) applies. For planet moons, the PlanetMoonProvider pattern (evaluate offset from parent's barycentric position) applies.

Note: JPL (DE441) doesn't include asteroids or planet moons. Returning an error for those bodies under JPL mode is correct — don't add a silent fallback to .se1 files.
execution_record: Straightforward extension — added `asteroid_files` and `planet_moon_files` fields to SwephProvider, routed Body::Asteroid (evaluate + sun_bary) and Body::PlanetMoon (parent bary + offset) in positions(), updated all 10 construction sites. pctr_bary_state now passes real file refs from Ephemeris; all other sites pass &[] since they use the dedicated wrapper providers. No golden tests added (no .se1 asteroid/plmoon pctr test data yet) — this unblocks the path but verification requires golden data generation.
